document_zh: 三区方案 B 登记：每区一个可辩的替代空间组合与一组三元决策条件
document_en: Plan-B register for the three key areas: one arguable alternative spatial combination per area, each with a three-way decision rule

statement_zh: 本文件登记的是比较，不是新的空间主张。三区的方案 A 是包内既有的首选组合，方案 B 由包内既有读数与既有候选推出，两案在同一套判据下比较。
方案 B 不是备份，也不是为衬托 A 而设的反例。每一个 B 案都指出 A 案的一处真实失败模式，并在该失败模式成立时优于 A。
本文件不选定任何一案。选择权属于取得授权的主体；本文件只把「选哪一案需要什么证据」写成可核对的形式。
全部空间动作仍为概念建议，不构成选址、控规、工程或审批结论；临时几何不支持地块级判断。
statement_en: What is registered here is a comparison, not a new spatial claim. Plan A in each area is the preferred combination the package already carries; Plan B is derived from readings and candidates the package already holds, and the two are compared under one set of criteria.
Plan B is neither a fallback nor a straw man set up to flatter Plan A. Each B names one real failure mode of its A and is the better option wherever that failure mode holds.
This file selects nothing. The choice belongs to an authorised body; all this file does is write down, in checkable form, what evidence choosing either option would take.
All spatial actions remain concept recommendations and constitute no siting, regulatory-plan, engineering or approval conclusion; the provisional geometry supports no parcel-level judgement.
declaration.relation_to_existing_files_zh: 本文件不重述以下文件已登记的内容，只登记它们之间此前未被写出的比较关系：visual/assets/district-strategy.json（街块诊断、开放化候选与其前提集合）、visual/assets/service-desk-gonogo.json（服务桌七项开办条件）、visual/assets/alignment-reference.json（主脊与安静线的廊道偏差读数）、visual/assets/spatial-audit-readings.json（六项审计读数，当前全部为零值）、risk.json（R-04、R-10、R-12）。
declaration.relation_to_existing_files_en: Nothing already registered in the following files is repeated here; what is registered is the comparison between them that had not been written down: visual/assets/district-strategy.json for block diagnosis, opening candidates and their preconditions, visual/assets/service-desk-gonogo.json for the desk's seven readiness conditions, visual/assets/alignment-reference.json for the corridor offsets of the spine and the quiet route, visual/assets/spatial-audit-readings.json for the six audit readings that all stand at zero, and risk.json for R-04, R-10 and R-12.
declaration.judgeability_declaration_zh: 本文件的全部条件分两类，逐条以 judgeability 字段标注：immediate（即时可判）指仅凭书面事实、字段取值或几何事实即可判定，不依赖现场读数与预注册阈值——权属方书面拒绝、付款方状态、开办条件具备项数、相关方书面意见、关闭态连续路径存否均属此类；pre_registered（须预注册后可判）指须先由三方复核组在测试前书面预注册口径与阈值、再以现场读数判定。每一对方案至少含一条 immediate 条件：六项审计读数当前全部为零值、无任何阈值已预注册，若三对的条件全部属 pre_registered，本登记在当前状态下将没有任何可执行的判断入口。条件状态另以 status 标注：unknown 指条件可判而事实尚未发生或尚未取得；not_yet_measurable 指阈值未预注册且相关读数为零值，当前不可判；known_zero 指该条凭包内既有零值登记在当前状态下已经成立。
declaration.judgeability_declaration_en: Every condition here falls into one of two classes, marked on each entry by the judgeability field. Immediate means it can be settled on a written fact, a field value or a geometric fact alone, without any site reading or pre-registered threshold: a rights holder's written refusal, a payer's status, a count of readiness conditions met, a written opinion from a relevant party, or whether a continuous AI-off route exists. Pre-registered means the three-party review must first register the definition and threshold in writing before measurement, and the reading then settles it. Each pair carries at least one immediate condition: the six audit readings all stand at zero and no threshold has been pre-registered, so if every condition in all three pairs were pre-registered this register would have no usable point of judgement in its present state. Status is marked separately: unknown means the condition can be judged but the fact has not yet occurred or not yet been obtained; not_yet_measurable means no threshold is pre-registered and the relevant reading is zero, so it cannot be judged at all today; known_zero means the condition already holds on a zero value the package has registered.

decision_rule.ternary_zh: 每对方案给三个分支而不是两个：继续选 A、切换 B、两者均放弃。第三个分支不是修辞——本包已经发生过一次：OP-04 的关闭态连续通道在提交几何上并不存在，处置是把节点退回未证成立状态而不是改写字段。凡两案都无法给出关闭态等价路径的片区，处置沿用同一裁决。
decision_rule.ternary_en: Each pair carries three branches, not two: keep A, switch to B, abandon both. The third is not rhetoric — it has already happened once in this package, when the AI-off continuous route at OP-04 turned out not to exist in the submitted geometry and the node was returned to an unproven state rather than the field being rewritten. Wherever neither option can produce an AI-off equivalent route, the same ruling applies.
decision_rule.threshold_pre_registration_zh: 凡条件涉及读数比较，阈值一律由三方复核组在测试前书面预注册且不可回溯，沿用 R-10 既定纪律。本文件不给任何阈值数值：六项审计读数当前全部为零值，先给数值等于用一个无依据的数字决定一次真实取舍。
decision_rule.threshold_pre_registration_en: Wherever a condition turns on a reading, the threshold is pre-registered in writing by the three-party review before measurement and is not retroactive, following the discipline already set in R-10. No threshold value is given here: the six audit readings all stand at zero, and stating a value now would let a baseless number settle a real choice.
decision_rule.switch_cost_rule_zh: 切换不附加额外程序门槛，与既有「允许降级，且降级不附加额外程序门槛」同口径。反之亦然：切换到 B 不因此免除 B 自身的前提集合。
decision_rule.switch_cost_rule_en: Switching carries no extra procedural hurdle, on the same footing as the existing rule that downgrading is allowed and adds no hurdle. The converse also holds: switching to B does not excuse B from its own preconditions.

pairs.debate_zh: 贯通 vs 边界渗透
pairs.debate_en: Cutting through versus permeating the edge

option_a.name_zh: 双带并列 + 贯通通道（ZZY-BK-01）
option_a.name_en: Two parallel bands plus a through-route at ZZY-BK-01
option_a.composition_zh: 主脊 ROAD-001 与低刺激安静替代线 ROAD-005 南北并列，验证在两带之间展开；开放化首选一条穿越 264409.2 平方米街块的公共通行线，该街块与主脊距离 0 米，最近节点 OP-01 距其 24.4 米。
option_a.composition_en: The spine ROAD-001 and the low-stimulation quiet route ROAD-005 run in parallel north to south with validation staged between them; the preferred opening action is a single public through-route across the 264409.2 square metre block that sits 0 metres from the spine, with OP-01 the nearest node at 24.4 metres.
option_a.what_it_buys_zh: 一次动作即改写该区超大块占街块面积 60.05% 的拓扑事实；关闭态东西向路径不必绕行该街块 3351.8 米的周长。
option_a.what_it_buys_en: One action rewrites the topological fact that oversized blocks hold 60.05 per cent of this area's block area, and the AI-off east-west route no longer has to go the 3351.8 metres round that block.
option_a.what_it_costs_zh: 前提最重：权属核验与内部通道现场调查两项均属本包无从判断的事项，四项前提任一不闭合，动作停在图纸上；且贯通线是单点结构，一处否决或一处权属拒绝即全案落空。
option_a.what_it_costs_en: Its preconditions are the heaviest: tenure verification and a field survey of internal passages are both beyond what this package can judge, and if any of the four preconditions fails to close the action stays on paper. The through-route is also a single-point structure, so one veto or one refusal of tenure takes the whole case down.
derived_from: proposal.md#片区策略：从街块诊断到设计回应

option_b.name_zh: 双带并列 + 边界渗透组合（ZZY-BK-02 与 ZZY-BK-04 边界渗透、ZZY-BK-03 角部开放）
option_b.name_en: Two parallel bands plus an edge-permeation set: perimeter permeation at ZZY-BK-02 and ZZY-BK-04 with a corner opening at ZZY-BK-03
option_b.composition_zh: 主脊与安静线的并列关系不变；全部开放化动作落在既有边界 way 与街块角部，不进入任何街块内部。验证内容由「穿越大院」改为「在四条边界上做等价路径与界面测试」，界面按活性、展示、静三类判据分段。
option_b.composition_en: The parallel relation of spine and quiet route is unchanged; every opening action sits on existing boundary ways and block corners and enters no block interior. Validation shifts from crossing a compound to testing equivalent routes and frontages along four edges, segmented by the active, display and quiet frontage classes.
option_b.what_it_buys_zh: 前提集合缩小到边界 way 与限定范围场地授权，在 G0 内闭合的可能性高于 A；三处动作互相独立，单点否决只损失一处渗透口，不影响其余两处。
option_b.what_it_buys_en: The precondition set shrinks to boundary ways and a bounded site permission, which stands a better chance of closing inside G0 than A does; and the three actions are independent, so one veto costs one permeation point rather than the case.
option_b.what_it_costs_zh: 拓扑上街块不被细分，60.05% 这一读数不变；东西向连续性依赖绕行，绕行系数的上升幅度未知，须以 JZ-01 实测判定。B 案不解决该区的核心诊断，只在诊断无法被解决时保住可执行动作。
option_b.what_it_costs_en: The block is not subdivided in the topology and the 60.05 per cent reading stands; east-west continuity relies on detours whose added factor is unknown until JZ-01 measures it. B does not solve this area's core diagnosis; it keeps an executable action alive for the case where the diagnosis cannot be solved.

keep_a.zh: 权属核验在 G0 内闭合，以权属方的书面确认为准。
keep_a.en: Tenure verification closes inside G0, evidenced by the rights holder's written confirmation.

keep_a.zh: 内部通道现场调查在 G0 内闭合，以调查记录存否为准，不涉任何阈值。
keep_a.en: The internal-passage field survey closes inside G0, judged on whether the survey record exists and turning on no threshold.

keep_a.zh: 拟贯通线全长不落在文物保护控制线、河道蓝线与消防疏散路径内（图面套合判定，沿用《首批试点点位选取准则》的法定控制线硬条件）。
keep_a.en: No part of the proposed through-route falls inside heritage control lines, watercourse blue lines or fire evacuation routes — an overlay check, on the hard statutory-control-line conditions already set in the pilot-site selection criteria.

switch_b.zh: keep_a 三项中任一项在 G0 期满仍为 unknown，或权属方书面拒绝。
switch_b.en: Any of the three keep-A conditions is still unknown when G0 closes, or the rights holder refuses in writing.

switch_b.zh: JZ-01 实测的绕行系数在两案间的差值，按测前预注册口径不足以支撑 A 的额外前提成本。阈值当前未预注册，绕行系数读数为零值。
switch_b.en: The detour-factor difference between the two options, measured under JZ-01, fails against the pre-registered definition to justify the extra preconditions A carries. No threshold is pre-registered and the detour reading stands at zero.

abandon_both.zh: 两案都无法在关闭态下给出一条不依赖 AI 的连续东西向路径。该条为几何连通性判定，不涉阈值。处置沿用 OP-04 既有裁决：相关节点保持审计状态、连续性字段如实登记、原路径字段一字不改，该区在取得新证据前不申报任何服务覆盖。
abandon_both.en: Neither option can produce a continuous east-west route that works with the AI off — a test of geometric connectivity, turning on no threshold. The ruling follows the one already made at OP-04: the nodes stay in audit state, the continuity field is registered as it is, the original route field is left untouched, and the area claims no service coverage until new evidence arrives.

switch_conditions.who_decides_zh: G3 独立复核（复核人未参与制作），异议按既有条款直接排入最近一次 G3 议程。
switch_conditions.who_decides_en: The G3 independent review, whose reviewers took no part in making what is reviewed; objections enter the next G3 agenda directly under the existing clause.

pairs.debate_zh: 平行安静线 vs 融合设计
pairs.debate_en: A parallel quiet route versus an integrated one

option_a.name_zh: 一街两院 + 独立平行安静替代线
option_a.name_en: One cross-street with two yards, plus a separate parallel quiet route
option_a.composition_zh: 共创横街连缀主脊两侧的公共院落；低刺激安静替代线 ROAD-005 全线与主脊并行，安静停靠点、绕行与恢复点挂在该线上，开放化以 AIO-BK-01 贯通通道与 AIO-BK-03 角部开放（OP-02 距 1.9 米）承接。
option_a.composition_en: A co-design cross-street links the public yards on both sides of the spine; the low-stimulation quiet route ROAD-005 runs parallel along its whole length and carries the quiet stopping points, detours and recovery points, with the opening actions taken up by the through-route at AIO-BK-01 and the corner opening at AIO-BK-03, 1.9 metres from OP-02.
option_a.what_it_buys_zh: 需回避噪声、人流与强光者不必与主脊人流协商即可走完全程；感官负荷可分线取样，与静界面夜间读数分开取样的既有口径一致。
option_a.what_it_buys_en: Anyone avoiding noise, crowds or glare can complete the whole route without negotiating the spine's footfall, and sensory load can be sampled per line, on the same footing as the existing rule that quiet-frontage night readings are sampled separately.
option_a.what_it_costs_zh: 两条线的维护同属纯公共底线类支出，安静线没有服务收入接口，在任何削减压力下是第一顺位目标；分离本身可被读作隔离，与「同一项服务、任何人都能独立完成」存在张力。更重的一处代价由包内已登记的张力给出：CB-03-T1 指出静界面判据（不设动态发光、不设主动声音输出）与夜间断点读数作用在同一段界面上，暗区越纯粹，夜间独行者遇到断点的风险越高。A 案把这条张力铺满全线——独立平行安静线全线按静界面组织，且不与主脊人流相邻，夜间形成一条连续的低监视度暗区；而既有判据中承担自然监视职能的一条只写到「每段静界面仍须有人工可及入口」，入口间距上限只写在活性界面类（三区分别约 50.5、41.0、31.1 米，取该值 0.8—1.0 倍），静界面类没有对应的间距判据。该风险由现场读数与相关方书面意见判定，本文件不提出照度数值、不提出巡查频次、不提出任何人群安全统计结论，也不指认任何具体人群的风险水平。安静线相对遗址公园廊道参考线的中位偏差 1389.166 米是位置读数而不是缺陷：按既有登记该读数不表示该线更偏离设计意图，服务网络与其参照系邻近而不重合，两案在这一点上没有差别。
option_a.what_it_costs_en: Both lines are upkeep of the plain public baseline class and the quiet route has no service-revenue interface, which makes it first in line under any pressure to cut; and separation can be read as segregation, which sits uneasily with the claim that anyone can complete the same service independently. The heavier cost comes from a tension the package already registers. CB-03-T1 states that the quiet-frontage criteria — no dynamic illumination, no active sound output — and the night-break reading act on the same stretch of frontage: the purer the dark zone, the higher the risk that a person walking alone at night meets a break. Option A spreads that tension along the whole line, since the separate parallel route is organised as quiet frontage end to end and does not sit beside the spine's footfall, forming one continuous stretch of low surveillance at night. The existing clause that carries the natural-surveillance function goes only as far as requiring that every stretch of quiet frontage still holds human-reachable entrances; the ceiling on entrance spacing is written into the active-frontage class alone (about 50.5, 41.0 and 31.1 metres in the three areas, at 0.8 to 1.0 of that value), and the quiet-frontage class carries no spacing criterion at all. Site readings and written opinions from the relevant parties settle this risk: no illuminance value, no patrol frequency, no safety statistic and no risk level for any specific group of people is proposed here. The quiet route's median offset of 1389.166 metres from the heritage park corridor reference line is a positional reading and not a defect: on the registration already made it does not indicate a greater departure from design intent, the service network sits near its reference frame without coinciding with it, and on this point the two options do not differ.

option_b.name_zh: 一街两院 + 主脊融合低刺激（取消独立安静线）
option_b.name_en: One cross-street with two yards, low stimulation folded into the spine, with no separate quiet route
option_b.composition_zh: 不设第二条线：主脊按静界面判据分段低刺激化，沿线布安静停靠点，并以既有四时段口径设低刺激时窗；光声变化预告与「转入不需要说明理由」两条动作不变，改变的只是它们发生在哪条线上。
option_b.composition_en: No second line: the spine is made low-stimulation in segments under the quiet-frontage criteria, quiet stopping points are placed along it, and low-stimulation windows are set using the four time bands the package already uses. Advance notice of light and sound changes and the rule that moving into the quiet option needs no explanation are unchanged; only the line they happen on changes.
option_b.what_it_buys_zh: 一条线的维护与值守结构单一，底线难以被「砍掉其中一条」这种方式蚕食；不把使用者按感官需求分流到不同空间，低刺激成为主脊的一种状态而不是另一处场所。B 案的第二处胜面在夜间安全：CB-03-T1 的暗区张力在本案中被结构性削弱——低刺激按段落在主脊上，暗区不连续，每一段两端都落在主脊活性界面的入口间距判据覆盖内，自然监护由主脊既有人流与既有人工可及入口提供，不靠新增照明、不靠新增巡查，因而不与「不设动态发光、不设主动声音输出」两条静界面判据正面冲突。B 案不宣称解决 CB-03-T1——该张力的状态仍为已识别未解决——只把它由全线连续风险降为分段风险，并使夜间断点读数落在既有的分段取样口径内。
option_b.what_it_buys_en: With one line the upkeep and staffing structure is single, and the baseline cannot be eroded by dropping one of two. Users are not sorted into different spaces by sensory need: low stimulation becomes a state of the spine rather than a separate place. B's second advantage is at night. The dark-zone tension of CB-03-T1 is structurally weakened here: low stimulation falls in segments along the spine, the dark stretches are not continuous, both ends of each segment lie inside the active-frontage entrance-spacing criterion, and natural surveillance comes from the spine's existing footfall and its existing human-reachable entrances rather than from added lighting or added patrols — so it does not collide head-on with the quiet-frontage rules against dynamic illumination and active sound. B claims no resolution of CB-03-T1, whose status remains identified and unresolved; it lowers the risk from continuous along a whole line to segment by segment, and keeps the night-break readings inside the segmented sampling definition already in force.
option_b.what_it_costs_zh: 低刺激条件在同一条线上与人流、活动与配送时段直接冲突；时窗是行政承诺而非空间事实，AI 关闭且无人值守时无从执行——B 把一个空间问题换成了一个值守问题，而值守正是劳动力短缺情景下最先短缺的资源。
option_b.what_it_costs_en: On one line the low-stimulation condition collides directly with footfall, events and delivery hours; and a time window is an administrative promise rather than a spatial fact, unenforceable once the AI is off and no one is on duty. B trades a spatial problem for a staffing one, and staffing is exactly what runs short first in the labour-shortage scenario.

keep_a.zh: S02 与 JZ-01 实测显示主脊在任一时窗内都无法把感官负荷超限点降到与独立线同一量级，比较口径与阈值测前预注册。阈值当前未预注册，感官负荷超限点读数为零值。
keep_a.en: Measurement under S02 and JZ-01 shows the spine cannot, in any time window, bring sensory-load exceedance points down to the same order as the separate line, against a definition and threshold pre-registered before measurement. No threshold is pre-registered and the exceedance-point reading stands at zero.

keep_a.zh: 安静线的付款方在 L3 申报时状态为已确认（funding_owner 字段取值判定）。
keep_a.en: The quiet route's funding owner reads confirmed at the point of declaring L3 — settled on the value of the funding_owner field.

keep_a.zh: 治安相关方（属地公安或场地安保责任方）就一条全线连续静界面的夜间独行安全出具书面意见且未指出风险，或授权主体的夜间安全评估结论为不需附加条件。凭书面件判定，不依赖读数与阈值。截至登记日本方案团队未与任何主体发生接触，不存在任何书面意见或评估，状态如实登记为 unknown。
keep_a.en: The relevant public-safety party — the local police authority or the party accountable for security on site — gives a written opinion on the night-time safety of a person walking alone along one continuous quiet-frontage line and identifies no risk; or an authorising body's night-safety assessment concludes that no added condition is required. Settled on the document, with no reading or threshold involved. As of the registration date the team has approached no party and no such opinion or assessment exists, so the status is registered truthfully as unknown.

switch_b.zh: 安静线的付款方在 L3 申报时仍为待确认；按既有规则该节点不得进入限定开放。此时保留一条完整的线优于保留两条各缺一半的线。
switch_b.en: The quiet route's funding owner is still to be confirmed when L3 is declared, which by the existing rule bars it from bounded opening. One whole line is then worth more than two half-kept ones.

switch_b.zh: 非 AI 通道底线三项承诺中任一项在安静线上被声明为可削减（声明性事实判定）。
switch_b.en: Any of the three non-AI channel floor commitments is declared reducible on that route — settled on the declaration itself.

switch_b.zh: 治安相关方的书面意见指出全线连续静界面存在夜间独行安全风险；或相关方拒绝就该线出具意见；或夜间安全评估结论要求以照明、巡查一类附加条件换取该线成立——附加条件与静界面判据（不设动态发光、不设主动声音输出）正面冲突，等于要求该线以放弃低刺激属性为代价存在。三种情形任一成立即切换 B：B 案的分段暗区结构把自然监护交给主脊既有人流与既有入口，不需要以附加照明或附加巡查换取。本条凭书面件判定，不依赖读数与阈值；状态 unknown。
switch_b.en: The written opinion identifies a night-time safety risk for a person walking alone along the continuous quiet-frontage line; or the relevant party declines to give an opinion on that line; or a night-safety assessment requires added lighting or patrols as the price of the line standing at all — an added condition that collides head-on with the quiet-frontage criteria against dynamic illumination and active sound, and so asks the line to exist by giving up the very property it exists for. Any one of the three switches to B, whose segmented structure hands natural surveillance to the spine's existing footfall and entrances instead of buying it with added lighting or patrols. Settled on the document, with no reading or threshold involved; status unknown.

abandon_both.zh: 两案都无法提供一条「不需要说明理由即可转入」的低刺激路径。该条为程序事实判定：凭规程文本与现场规则即可判断转入是否附加说明义务，不涉读数。
abandon_both.en: Neither option delivers a low-stimulation route one may move into without giving a reason. This is a procedural fact: the protocol text and the on-site rules show whether moving in carries a duty to explain, and no reading is involved.

abandon_both.zh: 两案的感官负荷超限点在预注册口径下均不低于主脊现状。阈值当前未预注册，读数为零值。
abandon_both.en: Under the pre-registered definition neither option brings sensory-load exceedance points below the spine as it stands. No threshold is pre-registered and the reading is zero.

switch_conditions.abandon_both_disposal_zh: 上述任一条成立时的处置：S02 退回 L2、不申报覆盖，并作为未解决障碍进入季度公开复盘，而不是把判据改低。
switch_conditions.abandon_both_disposal_en: Where either holds, the disposal is this: S02 returns to L2, claims no coverage, and enters the quarterly public review as an unresolved barrier — the criterion is not lowered.
switch_conditions.who_decides_zh: G3 独立复核，参与者代表在席；感官敏感与需低刺激环境者的角色组必须在该次复核的角色覆盖中出现，否则结论不成立。夜间安全一项另须治安相关方的书面意见在卷，缺件时该项按 unknown 处理，不得以推定代替。
switch_conditions.who_decides_en: The G3 independent review with participant representatives seated; the role group of people who are sensory-sensitive or need low-stimulation settings must appear in that review's role coverage, or the conclusion does not stand. On night-time safety a written opinion from the relevant public-safety party must additionally be on file; absent it the item stays unknown and no presumption stands in its place.

pairs.debate_zh: 固定三区分工 vs 可变网络
pairs.debate_en: A fixed division of roles between three areas versus a variable network

option_a.name_zh: 四向一厅 + 采用检验固定在本区（JZ-04，服务桌落于 PUBLIC-007）
option_a.name_en: Four approaches into one hall, with adoption testing fixed in this area under JZ-04 and the desk at PUBLIC-007
option_a.composition_zh: 四向路径在采用市场的四象限接口交汇成厅；万感服务桌四位序作为最小物理载体固定落位于该区的多通道商业前厅，支付替代、无账户服务与维护退出台随之。
option_a.composition_en: Four approach routes meet as a hall at the four-quadrant interfaces of the adoption market; the four stations of the Every-Sense service desk sit as the smallest physical carrier in this area's multichannel commercial forecourt, with payment alternatives, account-free service and the maintenance-and-exit counter alongside.
option_a.what_it_buys_zh: 采用检验与站点、商业前厅、支付替代绑定在一处，责任链最短；该区街块中位 969.0 平方米、界面粒度约 31.1 米、超大街块为零，是全场最适合做界面级采用检验的肌理。
option_a.what_it_buys_en: Adoption testing is bound in one place to the station, the commercial forecourt and payment alternatives, which makes the accountability chain the shortest available; and with a median block of 969.0 square metres, a frontage grain of about 31.1 metres and no oversized blocks at all, this is the fabric best suited to frontage-scale adoption testing.
option_a.what_it_costs_zh: 整条验证—共创—采用回路的最后一环押在单一片区的单一场地授权上。该项当前为 no-go，服务桌七项开办条件具备 0 项；A 案的失败模式是单点失败即整条回路无出口。
option_a.what_it_costs_en: The last link of the validate–co-design–adopt loop rests on one site permission in one area. That permission currently stands at no-go with none of the desk's seven readiness conditions met, so A fails in a way that leaves the whole loop without an outlet.

option_b.name_zh: 可迁移服务桌网络（采用检验按开办条件在十节点间轮转，本区为首选站而非唯一站）
option_b.name_en: A movable service-desk network: adoption testing rotates among the ten nodes as readiness allows, with this area the preferred stop rather than the only one
option_b.composition_zh: 空间上不新增任何设施，只把 JZ-04 的对外层级单元由「片区」改为「场景 × 点位」——与既有适用单元口径本就一致；服务桌四位序落在任一已具备七项开办条件的节点上，位序与「不消费也能停留」的承诺随桌迁移，不因迁移而简化。
option_b.composition_en: No facility is added; only the unit at which JZ-04 declares its level changes from the area to the scenario-by-node pair, which is the unit the package already uses. The four stations sit at whichever node has met the seven readiness conditions, and both the station order and the promise that one may stay without spending travel with the desk and are not simplified by the move.
option_b.what_it_buys_zh: 场地授权风险由单点变为可替换；与「工作包对外层级取其全部点位中的最低者」的既有规则天然相容；服务桌本就被登记为「制度里最容易被别的城市直接带走的一件东西」，可迁移是它的设计属性而不是妥协。
option_b.what_it_buys_en: Site-permission risk becomes replaceable rather than single-point, and the option sits naturally with the existing rule that a work package declares the lowest level among its nodes. The desk is already registered as the piece of this institution another city could most easily carry off, so being movable is a design property of it rather than a concession.
option_b.what_it_costs_zh: 采用检验失去与站点、商户与支付合规的固定绑定，支付替代与商户条件须逐站重谈；「大钟寺 = 包容采用市场」这句角色判词随之由定义降级为首选；每一次迁移都须完整走一遍双联交接台账，协调成本与交接次数同时上升。
option_b.what_it_costs_en: Adoption testing loses its fixed binding to the station, the merchants and payment compliance, so payment alternatives and merchant terms must be renegotiated stop by stop; the line that Dazhongsi is the inclusive adoption market drops from a definition to a preference; and every move must run the full duplicate handover ledger, raising both coordination cost and the number of handovers.

keep_a.zh: 场地授权取得且授权期同时覆盖试验期与撤除期（GD-1 场地授权，凭授权文件与其期限判定）。
keep_a.en: A site permission is obtained whose term spans both the trial period and removal — readiness condition GD-1, settled on the permission document and its term.

keep_a.zh: 责任角色表的 A 位可署名（GD-2 责任角色表，凭署名存否判定）。两项须同时成立。
keep_a.en: The A position on the accountability matrix is nameable — readiness condition GD-2, settled on whether a signature exists. Both conditions must hold at once.

switch_b.zh: keep_a 两项在 G0 期满仍为空缺。
switch_b.en: Both keep-A conditions are still blank when G0 closes.

switch_b.zh: 本区的商户与支付条件无法闭合，而其他节点已具备七项开办条件（凭各节点开办条件具备项数判定）。JZ-04 在既有依赖表中本就登记为「非关键路径、可因商户条件延后而不阻断其余工作包」，切换 B 是把这条既有登记执行到底，而不是新开一条路线。
switch_b.en: This area's merchant and payment terms cannot be closed while another node has met all seven readiness conditions — settled on the count of conditions met at each node. JZ-04 is already registered as off the critical path and able to slip on merchant terms without blocking the others; switching to B carries that registration through rather than opening a new route.

abandon_both.zh: 十个节点中没有任何一处能同时满足七项开办条件（具备项数计数判定）。当前读数：服务桌七项开办条件具备 0 项，本条在当前状态下已成立，因此采用环节保持既有的生态环节覆盖 0 / 7 登记状态，JZ-04 停在 L0，不以桌面演示、图纸或一次活动替代；本方案不以「先办起来再补材料」推进。
abandon_both.en: Not one of the ten nodes meets all seven readiness conditions — settled by counting conditions met. Current reading: none of the desk's seven is met, so this condition already holds today. The adoption stage therefore keeps its registered ecosystem coverage of zero of seven, JZ-04 stays at L0, and nothing — a tabletop demonstration, a drawing or a single event — is substituted for it; this proposal does not proceed by opening first and filing later.

switch_conditions.who_decides_zh: G3 独立复核；A 与 B 之间的切换以点位为单位申请与执行，单点切换不触发整包回退。
switch_conditions.who_decides_en: The G3 independent review; switching between A and B is applied for and carried out node by node, and a single switch triggers no package-wide rollback.

limitations_en: This file registers a comparison of options. It is not a siting conclusion, a feasibility study or an investment decision document.
It does not rule on which option is better; the three-way conditions state what evidence is required, not what this proposal prefers.
It produces no metric value; the six audit readings and the seven inclusion metrics stay at zero or unknown.
Every reading quoted comes from registrations already in the package, on a snapshot or concept footing, and is neither field measurement nor official data.
